Reimagining how product teams make decisions with AI

Verizon Value (6 brands) · Lead Product Designer (Agentic UX & AI Systems) · 2025–present

The problem was never the tools; it was where decisions got made. Ten agents — a shared Master Brain, an edge-case detector, a CX strategist grounded in real heuristics — moved product, design and engineering decisions earlier, where fixing them costs a fraction of what it costs in development.

Agentic UX · Design languageAgentic UX · デザイン言語

intentfirst.ai

Founder Own venture自身のベンチャー

intentfirst.ai is a design-language framework — Context Grammar — giving AI systems the vocabulary to understand intent, not just input. Defines 8 Context Tokens and a 3-layer memory model, demonstrated across three applied projects.

What I did · what the team did自分がしたこと · チームがしたこと

What I did自分がしたこと

  • Defined the Context Grammar framework: 8 structured Context Tokens describing who a user is in the moment, not just what they said
  • Designed the 3-layer memory model — Identity, Accumulated Learning, Right Now
  • Built 3 applied demonstration projects: The Living Home, The Family Trip, Fluid Handoff
  • Published the framework and site at intentfirst.ai

Agentic commerce · Conceptエージェント型コマース · コンセプト

Amazon Shopping on Fire TV

Design & Engineering · 2026 Self-initiated concept自主制作コンセプト

A self-built proof of concept reimagining Amazon shopping for a 10-foot TV interface: D-pad browsing, Alexa-style voice shopping, and a paired phone that becomes remote, keyboard and mic via a QR-code pairing layer. Built solo with vanilla HTML/CSS/JS, Firebase and the Web Speech API. Not affiliated with Amazon; product data and voice replies are simulated.

What I did · what the team did自分がしたこと · チームがしたこと

What I did自分がしたこと

  • Designed a 10-foot commerce interface where the TV is the stage and the phone is the input device
  • Built D-pad navigation for discovery and Alexa-style voice for intent
  • Built a phone-as-remote web app (keyboard, precise pointer, private mic) with instant QR pairing, no download or login
  • Built on own open-source 'snap-pair' pairing pattern — QR/6-character code, presence heartbeat, room membership, cleanup
  • Mirrored cart, screen and search state to the phone in real time
  • Built the entire prototype solo — vanilla HTML/CSS/JS, Firebase and the Web Speech API

Enterprise design system · FinTechエンタープライズのデザインシステム · FinTech

Credit Card Web Portal Redesign · First PREMIER Bank

First PREMIER Bank · Lead Product Designer · 2022

Led a discovery audit of First PREMIER Bank's credit card portal that found the root cause was a total absence of design infrastructure, not cosmetic issues. Prioritized 4 of 10 flows for rebuild — account setup, login, summary, payments — and built a 125+ component design system in three layers, later adopted org-wide, including by the mobile app team's 2022 v2.0.

What I did · what the team did自分がしたこと · チームがしたこと

What I did自分がしたこと

  • Led the discovery audit to find the structural root cause rather than catalog every individual problem
  • Identified that the portal's issues stemmed from a complete absence of design infrastructure, not cosmetic problems
  • Set the two-level fix: rebuild the critical flows for immediate impact, and build a system to prevent recurrence
  • Prioritized 4 of 10 flows by frequency times pain severity — account setup, login, summary, payments
  • Led design direction, system architecture and screen delivery across the full engagement
  • Built the design system in three layers: foundation tokens, components, and patterns

What I'm exploring nowいま探っていること

Human × AI: fix the architecture first.人 × AI：まず構造を直す。

AI amplifies whatever architecture it lands on. If knowledge is fragmented, AI returns fragmented answers faster. The design work is upstream of the model.

Agentic UX starts from intent, not from the screen.Agentic UX は画面ではなく意図から始まる。

AI knows what you asked. It doesn't know what you need. A product that reads physical state, cognitive load and how much autonomy someone wants is a different kind of product.

MyBrainSpec Validating検証中

Can a short self-administered check produce a genuinely useful, personalized profile of how someone's attention and memory actually behave?

A short, structured self-check can surface genuine patterns in a person's own attention and memory — worth reflecting back as a written profile.

I build the tools I build withつくるための道具も、つくる

Open-source tools that came out of building AI products. I don't just use AI tools; I build them.AI プロダクトを作る過程から生まれたオープンソースの道具。AI の道具を使うだけでなく、作る。

  • superforge Say what you want to build in one sentence — fourteen skills take it from idea to accessibility-checked, pre-launch ready, in the right order and on the right model. Claude Code · Codex · Gemini · MIT
  • Snap Pair A React + Firebase pairing layer that lets every phone in the room join an app in one scan. React · Firebase · MIT
  • failforward A zero-dependency CLI that records failures and recalls the useful lessons before similar work starts. Python · Claude Code · Codex · MIT
  • cross-model-handoff A lightweight note-and-passphrase protocol for moving active work between AI tools without losing context. Claude Code · Codex · Gemini · MIT
